srList.sentence: The Institute of Medicine26 recommends the following criteria in terms of GWG taking into account the pre-pregnancy weight: for underweight women (body mass index BMI <18.5 kgm2), the recommended GWG is 12.5 to 18 kg for normal-weight women (BMI = 18.5-24.9 kgm2), the recommended GWG is 11.5 to 16 kg regarding overweight women (BMI = 25-29.9 kgm2), the recommended GWG is 7.00 to 11.5 kg whereas for obese ones (BMI >30 kgm2), the recommended GWG is 5 to 9 kg.
